_about: PERFGATES budget: the numbers behind the islands plan's section 1.7 budget table (docs/design/islands-and-loop-plan.md). game/tests/t_perfgates.gd reads this file, builds the home island and the two unstable islands listed here, and gates the headless measures on these numbers. Edit a number here, not in the test. A measure the headless run cannot take (web build time, camp-view primitives/draws/shadows, web frame p95) is listed under not_headless and printed as 'not measured headless' - never faked.
_enforce_note: A measure with its own "enforce" entry is gated by that entry (build_ms has one: it is under budget on all three islands). Measures without one are gated by this top-level flag, still false because the plan has one known miss left (the heap, ~171 MB against 90, owned by another job): those over-budget measures are printed and reported, never silently dropped, and the measurement itself is always asserted (builds happen, counters agree, cells are 32 m and shadowless).

build_ms._rule: Island build, native: <= home_max on the home island, <= unstable_max on an unstable one
build_ms._note: The island's figure is the fastest of 5 builds (t_buildspeed); the single build t_perfgates measures is judged the same way. Other jobs on this box only add wall-clock time to a build, they never make one finish early. The worst of the five is printed beside it and must stay under the budget + overrun_pct.

scene_nodes._rule: Scene nodes the build adds (Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT delta) <= max

ground_cover._rule: Ground cover is one MultiMesh per 32 m cell, no shadow, drawn to at least 120 m; instances per island <= max_instances
ground_cover._max_instances_note: # ASSUMPTION: the plan gives the mechanism, not a count; this ceiling only catches a runaway regression (today's cover is ~52k instances per island).

creatures._rule: The plan's cap is 24 creatures per island; the home island's target is 11 (spawner top-up). A home count under target is printed as UNDER but is a content shortfall, not a perf breach, so only the cap gates.

heap_mb._rule: Static memory the build adds to the process <= max MB
